extraction.NOTES: This is an administrative cover letter from J. A. Buntin, District Superintendent in Charge, to the Commissioner of Indian Affairs, dated November 8, 1928, acknowledging receipt of Circular No. 2464 dated June 18, 1928. The agency reports a list of about 80 Indians who received fee patents without applying for same, prior to 1921. The letter inquires whether information should be submitted as gathered or all at once, and whether all heirs of deceased allottees must be questioned or only a representative; one case noted has as many as thirteen heirs. No individual allottee record is described in this document.
